data.narrative:
Rebel Space is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Carrie and Gabriel Hernandez that has raised $2.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI—all operating in the same sector at Seed or Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression approach uses the $2.8M in total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $7M. The Peer-Median method references three same-sector comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed stage, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A), producing a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

These two methods produce a wide triangulated range of $6M to $460M, with a median of $204M. The substantial spread reflects the high variance in Defense & Security valuations at early stages and differing maturity levels within the peer set. Stage-Progression, anchored to minimal capital deployed, suggests a floor near $6M–$7M. Peer-Median, driven by high-value Seed and Series A comparables, anchors toward $400M. Key uncertainties include the specific technology differentiation versus named competitors and trajectory of revenue or customer traction not reflected in this data.
